newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - Bullish trade in BP, BT active.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - Bullish trade in BP, BT active.

text.p: Options in British Petroleum Co Plc and British Telecommunications Plc were the main focus of interest among stock options on Tuesday, traders said.

In BP almost 2,000 lots were traded with activity centred on the January 700p calls. The stock was up 4-1/2p at 643 after the oil company posted third-quarter net replacement profit at the top end of the range of analyst expectations.
"People are still speculating on a fairly sharp rise in BP shares," said one options specialist.
BT options were active for a second day after the phone group's merger plan with MCI Communications Inc.
Activity among BT options included a "put spread" of over 10,000 contracts, selling the November 390 puts and buying the May 420 puts -- indicating a short-term bullish view on the stock.
"Selling the near-month puts suggests the hope of a big rise short-term," said another options specialist. BT shares were down 3-1/2p at 369.
